title: Understanding Cross-Entropy Loss
text: Cross-entropy loss is used to measure the performance of a classification model whose output is a probability value between $$0$$ and $$1$$. It increases as the predicted probability diverges from the actual label.

text: For Row $$1$$, where $$y=0$$ and $$ŷ=0.45$$, the loss is calculated as: $$-\ln\left(1-0.45\right)$$. What is the value?

title: Calculate Loss for Row $$2$$

title: Mean Cross-Entropy Loss
text: The mean cross-entropy loss is the average of the individual losses. Add the losses from each row and divide by the number of rows.
